description: The bar chart illustrates the task count comparison across different language families for three models: mBERT, XLM-R, and same/better performance. The horizontal axis contains nine categories representing language families, labeled as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, listed in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "task count" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, marked at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of three bars: light blue for "better" performance, dark blue for XLM-R, and green for "same" performance. The bar heights vary across categories, with IE-Slavic having the tallest dark blue bar at approximately 38 and Isolate, Semitic, and IE-Indic having the shortest bars overall. Notably, the green bars are generally shorter than the dark blue bars, except for IE-Germanic and IE-Romance, where the green bars are significantly taller, at around 22 and 30, respectively. The bars are grouped by category, with no apparent sorting within the groups, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
